name: Pradhan Mantri Viksit Bharat Rozgar Yojana
description: Employment-linked incentive scheme providing financial incentives to first-time EPFO-registered employees and employers generating additional employment. Active 1 August 2025 to 31 July 2027. Formerly known as the Employment Linked Incentive (ELI) Scheme.
benefits: First-time employee incentive: up to ₹15,000 in two instalments (Part A)
Employer incentive: up to ₹3,000/month per additional eligible employee in all sectors (Part B)
Extended incentive for manufacturing sector employers (up to 4 years)
humanReadableEligibility: For employees: must be a first-time EPFO member (no prior EPFO membership before 1 August 2025), joining an eligible establishment between 1 August 2025 and 31 July 2027, with gross wages below ₹1 lakh/month. For employers: must be an EPFO-registered establishment creating net additional employment.
